Spatial-causal evidence-guided heterogeneous graph ranker

SC-HGNN-Rank Explorer

Spatial-Causal Heterogeneous Graph Neural Network Ranker. Interactive browser for model-prioritized compound-target-regulator-cell-space axes. The model ranks candidate mechanisms; external evidence layers are shown as post-lock support, not as training inputs.

DrugCLIP / GenomeScreenDB external validation

DrugCLIP/GenomeScreenDB is integrated as post-lock structural evidence. It can strengthen target-druggability interpretation and translational prioritization, but it does not change the locked SC-HGNN-Rank model.
Final-axis status
Export query/result templates
Use these files to query DrugCLIP/GenomeScreenDB, then paste or replace the result templates in the validation folder and rerun the integration script.

Full internal evidence workbench

This section exposes all evidence-audited candidate axes, not only the three manuscript axes. Click any axis to inspect its model, spatial, GRN, PPI/MSI, directness, drug, clinical and DepMap context.
Rows are the 24 retained evidence-audited candidates. This matrix is the main interactive evidence layer for non-final and backup axes.

Clinical prognosis support

Clinical evidence is summarized as same-cancer multi-cohort Cox/prognosis support. It is one post-ranking evidence layer for interpretation and convergence, not a single TCGA Kaplan-Meier significance gate.

All retained candidate-axis prognosis rows

This table uses the full selected-axis clinical validation matrix, not only the three final manuscript axes.

Gene-level clinical summary for targets and regulators

Clinical-layer interpretation boundary

Prognosis support does not prove drug efficacy or causal intervention. TCGA K-M images are retained only as backup supplementary assets in km_curves_2026-05-11/km_curve_index_2026_05_11.csv and are not shown as a core screening page.

Full-library cell-type screening results

This section exposes the broader exploratory screening pool across cell types. It is separate from the final 24 evidence-audited axes, so low-frequency cell types can still be inspected and exported.
Interpretation boundary: full-library rows are exploratory candidates. The manuscript-level axes are selected only after model ranking, spatial recurrence, GRN/PPI, directness, drug sensitivity and clinical evidence convergence.

Custom weighting and shortlist simulator

Use this as a practical deployment layer: adjust evidence weights, re-rank candidates, inspect alternatives, then export the filtered or reweighted shortlist for downstream validation planning.
Weight presets
Weights are normalized automatically for the custom score. This does not change the manuscript model; it helps users explore their own prioritization assumptions.
Top reweighted candidates

Practical deployment tools

Use this section when another user wants to test their own compound-target list, save a shortlist, or export a validation package without changing the manuscript model.

User candidate upload

Upload CSV/TSV with columns: cancer, compound, target, tf, cell. This performs local evidence matching against the locked discovery pool; it is not model retraining.
cancer,compound,target,tf,cell COAD,Quercetin,CDK1,MYB,Myeloid LIHC,4',5-DHF,AR,HDAC1,T_NK_ILC

Shortlist and validation plan

Save axes while browsing, then export a cell-experiment plan with compound, target, TF, niche and readout fields.

Report generator

Generate a compact HTML evidence report for the selected axis or current filtered table. Use the browser print dialog to save as PDF.

Explore model screening results

Use this table as the interactive supplement for all retained candidates. Search by compound, target, TF, cell type, tier, or axis id.
Claim boundary: computational prioritization only. Original-compound direct evidence is not the same as therapeutic efficacy; target-class drug-screen support is labeled separately.
Evidence provenance and claim boundary

Evidence provenance and claim boundary

Each evidence layer is shown with a claim boundary so users do not mistake post-lock validation evidence for model-training input or direct therapeutic proof.
